It’s essentially a full Linux userland sitting inside Android with:

✅ full Bash/Zsh support,

✅ package manager (pkg, apt),

✅ Python, Node, Git, OpenSSL, curl, jq, etc.,

✅ read/write access to /storage/emulated/0/,

✅ and the ability to run background daemons, cron-like jobs, and HTTP servers.

So when we port your Supabase + MetaBlooms automation to Termux, we’re not “faking it” — we’re running a real backend environment.
